changelog: The order screen's "Items in this parcel" groups a build sold by Creative Skateboard Builder as WooCommerce Product Bundles shows a bundle: a heading with the kit's name and the parts indented beneath it. Every part keeps its own quantity field, so a build can still go in more than one parcel. A "Whole build" box on the heading fills each empty part with what is left to ship, or empties them all, and shows as mixed when only some are chosen; it is never sent with the form, and stays hidden without JavaScript (assets/admin-order-items.js, loaded only for an order holding a build). The kit's line, which has nothing to ship (the builder's kits are virtual), is the heading only, unless the parcel being changed already lists it. Parts already in a parcel, what is checked on saving and the field names are as before, and an order with no build shows the form exactly as before.
